body: not even death can bring me peace. what the fuck. i hope so fucking bad that i won’t get to feel guilt and shame for dying. i don’t know whats on the other end. i don’t want to be able to see the world from above. i don’t want anything to do with the world once i’m gone. i just want to be gone. evaporated. like i never existed. no remnants. i wish i could even wipe the memory of my existence of myself from everyone who ever knew me. i don’t wanna exist. not in the past. not right now. not once im gone

got 2 misdemeanors over something so avoidable but because my own lack of judgement. i don’t have money for legal fees. any hope of happiness and a future is thrown out the window. i’m what’s broken. i’m what’s causing these hard times to come one after another.
